question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Trailing-four-quarter operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, back above one after fiscal 2025 printed {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, the weakest of the six fiscal years on record (the others run from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} to {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}). Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, negative again, whereas the fiscal 2025 annual cell was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets.value}, the only positive value among the five filled years. Working capital: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} year over year ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income), inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}), and accounts payable rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, supplying cash worth {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income. The payables rise is the largest single working-capital contributor to the rebound in cash conversion, and no paragraph in either report explains it. Articulation gaps are small: receivables {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}, inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}, payables {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}; the cash-flow statement and balance sheet agree. Two other operating lines moved sharply and are unexplained: other operating assets absorbed far more cash than a year earlier, and other operating liabilities swung from a use to a source of cash (numbers items cited). Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: quarterly net income moves less than quarterly operating cash flow, a mild smoothing signature that is consistent with a seasonal business but is noted. The quarterly accruals cell is empty because the filing states operating cash flow only for nine months; the calculator's derived quarterly operating cash flow ({growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}) is up {growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} year over year, ahead of net income growth of {growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash conversion is sound and has recovered from the fiscal 2025 low, but part of the recovery is supplied by rising payables and an unexplained swing in other operating liabilities rather than by earnings alone

revenue_recognition.finding: Quarterly days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, second highest of the six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} a quarter earlier but slightly below the year-ago quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}; on a trailing average basis it is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding} days. The fiscal 2025 annual DSO of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} was the highest of five years, so receivables have been drifting up against revenue over several years, not just this quarter. Receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} year over year while quarterly revenue grew {growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}; receivables growth is not outrunning revenue this quarter. One customer's share of trade receivables rose to {concentration.facts.11.value|pct} from {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} at fiscal year-end, and the notes give no reason; carriers as a group fell to {concentration.facts.12.value|pct} from {concentration.facts.4.value|pct}. Contract liabilities over revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}, third highest of six quarters, below the year-ago quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}; deferred revenue is not moving against revenue. The revenue note history records only date roll-forwards and amount changes: no policy wording change, no new variable-consideration, principal-versus-agent or standalone-selling-price judgment, no bill-and-hold or extended-terms language. Revenue is seasonally concentrated in the December quarter (quarter-over-quarter revenue growth of {growth.revenue.quarter_over_quarter|pct} this quarter is the normal seasonal step-down), not in the fiscal fourth quarter. Nothing found on policy changes; the receivables drift and the single-customer concentration are the findings.
revenue_recognition.verdict: revenue recognition looks clean on policy; receivables are elevated against the company's own history and one customer's share has risen without explanation

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Allowance for credit losses, inventory valuation reserve and warranty accrual are not tagged for any period in the record, so no reserve ratio can be tested against history; the calculator says so and this analysis cannot fill the gap. The largest estimate-driven lift to income this quarter is the tariff refund recognised as a reduction of products cost of sales: quarterly gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value}, highest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin.value} a year earlier and a fiscal 2025 annual margin of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value}. The release sizes the refund at about two percentage points of margin and eleven cents of diluted EPS; no tagged fact and no calculator field isolates the amount, so no adjustment can be written for it, and a margin without the refund does not exist in the input. Further refunds are a gain contingency of undisclosed size that management recognises only on receipt. On tax, the MD&A cites changes in unrecognized tax benefits (a judgmental reserve) among the items lowering the effective rate, with no amount; the trailing effective rate in the calculator is {tax_rate.value|pct}. No goodwill impairment test, discount-rate or growth assumption appears in the input. Cash taxes paid fell year over year while the provision rose, which the MD&A ties to completing the deemed repatriation payments. No estimate change that raises income is disclosed beyond the refund and the tax reserve wording.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: a non-operating refund sits inside the quarter's record gross margin and a tax-reserve change lowers the rate, both unquantified in the 10-Q; the reserve ratios that would normally be tested are untagged

cost_deferral.finding: No capitalized software development cost is tagged for the period, so the capitalized-over-expensed ratio cannot be computed; the notes say the new internal-use software standard is under evaluation and would, once adopted, move some costs from expense to the balance sheet, which is a forward signal to watch. Research and development is fully expensed and rising fast: trailing four quarters are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value}, and the numbers reader shows the quarterly step-up that MD&A ties to AI infrastructure and headcount. Soft asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}, third highest of six quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}; the rise coincides with the 8-K balance sheet printing a separate intangible-assets line that grew sharply from fiscal year-end while no acquisition line appears on the cash-flow statement ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.inputs.acquisitions.cash_spent}), and the 10-Q tags a different net intangible figure for the same dates (see cross-document reconciliation). Other non-current assets also rose. No non-GAAP measure exists in the record, so there is no non-GAAP to GAAP gap; the release presents no reconciliation, only the refund call-outs. No item is labelled non-recurring; the tariff refund is described as recognised on receipt and may repeat, the opposite pattern (a favourable item that is not carved out).
cost_deferral.verdict: no cost deferral found; research and development is expensed as incurred, but soft assets and intangibles are growing from an undisclosed source and the intangible figure does not agree between the release and the tagged 10-Q

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: No receivables factoring and no supplier-finance obligation is tagged in any period (the calculator's proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables and supplier-finance-obligation fields are both marked missing), so operating cash flow is not visibly lifted by either programme. What does lift it is trade payables: days payables outstanding are {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding} against days sales of inventory of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory} and DSO of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}, a cash conversion cycle of {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle} days, and the year-over-year payables rise supplied {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income in cash. A benign reading is that payables track the component build; the filing does not say. Off balance sheet: tagged unrecorded unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value}, while the MD&A states manufacturing purchase obligations and other purchase obligations in far larger amounts that no calculator field carries; the two measures have different definitions and the input does not reconcile them. Operating lease liability is not stated in the 10-Q, so the calculator carries the fiscal year-end figure {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability.value}. No guarantee maximum exposure and no variable-interest entity is tagged. Classification: purchases of marketable securities in investing roughly tripled year over year while operating cash flow rose, and no line moved between operating and investing; the 8-K cash-flow statement matches the 10-Q facts line by line. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} is treated as a real cost in {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value}; unrecognized RSU cost is large and grant-date fair values are rising, so the cost will grow.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: no factoring or supply-chain finance visible; cash is supplied by long payable terms and a payables build, and large purchase commitments sit off balance sheet beside supply-constraint language

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: The controls item concludes disclosure controls effective with no material weakness, remediation or change in internal control; no auditor's report or review report is in the input, so no critical audit matter can be checked. No late-filing notice and no amendment. Three officer-change 8-K filings fall in or before the quarter, including one inside it, and none of their bodies is in the input, so whether a finance officer departed cannot be told; the notes-text reader flags that the general counsel named in a new trading-plan disclosure may or may not relate to it. Two new prearranged trading plans were adopted in the quarter, by the general counsel and by the chief executive. One prior-period value was quietly re-reported: other non-current assets at fiscal year-end print differently in the 10-K and in the current 10-Q, with total assets unchanged at {terms.balances_now.assets.value} now against the year-end figure, and the 8-K balance sheet now shows a separate intangible-assets line absent from the 10-K facts; no restatement trace explains the reclassification. No related-party disclosure, subsidiary-list change or SEC comment letter is in the input (the subsidiary-list exhibit and risk-factor diffs were not provided).
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: no control failure disclosed, but a silent balance-sheet reclassification of a prior-period value, three unexplained officer-change filings and new insider trading plans are signals the input cannot close

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K release's statements of operations, balance sheet and nine-month cash-flow statement match the tagged 10-Q facts on every line except one: the release prints intangible assets, net, at both June 2026 and September 2025 at values that differ from the 10-Q's tagged net intangible figure for the same dates, and the input gives no reason. That is a contradiction between the two documents, not an unresolved item. The release's headline claims (June-quarter records for revenue, EPS and operating cash flow; records for iPhone, Mac and Services) are directionally confirmed by the numbers: quarterly revenue up {growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}, operating income up {growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct}, net income up {growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}, derived quarterly operating cash flow of {growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value} up {growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}; the release does not itself state a quarterly operating cash flow, and record status against all prior June quarters is not testable from the fields. The release's double-digit growth in every geographic segment is not testable without arithmetic this analysis may not do; every segment is higher per the numbers reader. The release quantifies the tariff refund (about two points of margin, eleven cents of EPS) while the 10-Q MD&A names it without an amount; the two documents agree on the direction and on where it sits (products cost of sales). iPad is the one category the 10-Q says declined, and the release omits it from its record list, which is consistent. The per-item outcomes are in the reconciliation table.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: the release and the 10-Q agree on every statement line but intangible assets, which contradict; the release quantifies a favourable item the 10-Q leaves unquantified

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: quarterly days sales of inventory are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, highest of six quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} a quarter earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} a year earlier; inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} year over year and the build sits in raw materials and purchased parts, not finished goods, which fits the MD&A's supply-constraint and memory-cost language (pre-buying components) rather than unsold product. No inventory reserve is tagged, so obsolescence coverage cannot be tested; the new inventory table in the notes carries no prose. Purchase commitments in excess of need: tagged unconditional purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} and the MD&A states much larger manufacturing obligations mostly payable within a year, alongside an expectation that supply and cost pressures will intensify; the input gives no prior-period comparison, so excess over need cannot be judged, but commitments plus a component build plus stated price increases that may reduce demand is the combination to watch. Customer concentration: one customer holds {concentration.facts.11.value|pct} of trade receivables (up from {concentration.facts.3.value|pct} at fiscal year-end and {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} last quarter); no revenue-benchmark concentration is tagged. Channel stuffing: nothing found; DSO is below the year-ago quarter, contract liabilities are stable, and no extended-terms language appears. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found in the sense of investing in a customer; the company does carry vendor non-trade receivables concentrated in two vendors ({concentration.facts.13.value|pct} and {concentration.facts.14.value|pct}) arising from component sales to suppliers whose gains are deferred until final products are sold, a long-standing arrangement that is disclosed and stable against last year's {concentration.facts.5.value|pct}.
industry_lens.verdict: the inventory build is in components and is explained by supply constraints rather than by unsold product; single-customer receivable concentration has risen without explanation; no channel stuffing or circular financing found

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름 대비 순이익 비율은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}로, 2025 회계연도의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}에서 회복했고 발생액 비율도 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}로 다시 음수가 되었습니다. 다만 회복분의 상당 부분은 매입채무 증가(순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct})와 설명되지 않은 기타 영업부채 변동이 공급한 현금이며, 현금흐름표와 재무상태표의 차이는 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap} 수준으로 작습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 분기 매출채권회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}일로 여섯 분기 중 두 번째로 높고, 한 고객의 매출채권 비중이 {concentration.facts.3.value|pct}에서 {concentration.facts.11.value|pct}로 올랐지만 이유는 공시되지 않았습니다. 수익인식 정책 문구 변경이나 새로운 판단 영역은 없으며 계약부채 비율 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}도 안정적입니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 분기 매출총이익률 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value}는 여섯 분기 중 최고치이지만 과거에 낸 관세의 환급이 매출원가 차감으로 포함되어 있고, 10-Q에는 그 금액이 없어 조정할 필드도 없습니다. 대손충당금·재고평가충당금·보증충당부채는 어떤 기간에도 태깅되지 않아 충당금 축소 여부를 검증할 수 없고, 세율을 낮춘 미인식 세무효익 변동도 금액이 없습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 연구개발비는 최근 네 분기 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value}로 급증했지만 전액 비용 처리되어 자본화 이연은 발견되지 않았습니다. 다만 소프트 자산 비중이 {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}에서 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value}로 오르고 무형자산이 늘었는데, 그 출처는 입력 자료에 없습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망금융은 태깅되어 있지 않아 영업현금흐름을 인위적으로 높인 흔적은 없습니다. 대신 매입채무회전일수 {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}일과 매입채무 증가가 현금을 공급했고, 태깅된 무조건 구매의무 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations.value} 외에 훨씬 큰 제조 구매의무가 부외로 존재하며, 주식보상비용 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}는 실질 비용으로 이미 차감되어 있습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 결론지었고 중요한 취약점이나 지연 공시는 없습니다. 그러나 전기 기타 비유동자산 수치가 설명 없이 재분류되었고, 본문이 없는 임원 변경 8-K가 세 건 있으며, 최고경영자와 법무책임자가 새 거래 계획을 채택했습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 보도자료와 10-Q는 무형자산 한 줄을 제외한 모든 재무제표 항목이 일치하며, 무형자산은 두 문서가 서로 다른 값을 보여 모순으로 기록했습니다. 보도자료의 기록 경신 주장은 매출 {growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}, 순이익 {growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct}, 파생 분기 영업현금흐름 {growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct}의 전년 대비 증가로 방향은 확인되지만, 관세 환급 효과는 보도자료에서만 수치화되어 있습니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일로 여섯 분기 중 최고치이지만 증가분이 완제품이 아닌 원재료·부품에 있어 부품 부족에 대비한 선매입으로 읽히며, 재고평가충당금은 태깅되지 않아 진부화 검증은 불가능합니다. 채널 밀어내기나 순환 거래의 징후는 없고, 공급업체 비영업 매출채권은 두 업체에 {concentration.facts.13.value|pct}와 {concentration.facts.14.value|pct}로 집중되어 있으나 전년과 비슷한 수준입니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
